scope: GUI drag, minimize, close, reinjection, F9 road-assist toggle and brake entry
Verified key input, stale delivery and late presses; F8/focus/countdown/seat releases
Partial pedal averages and digital steering averages at 30/60/120 Hz, including small inputs
Native analog input and handling/brake restoration without multiplier compounding
Conservative fallback grip, wet/surface grip, native braking preview and high-grip rollover steering limits
Full rotated-car corridor envelope, boundary guard, upright damping and obstacle trajectory alternatives
Independent ghost decoder, capture rejection and saved collision-road alignment
Generated script byte consistency, Luau compilation and no direct score/network/teleport calls

planar_driving.model: Independent planar bicycle; actuator lag and grip cap; no Roblox suspension/collisions/networking

planar_setup.steering: Digital turn/return-rate approximation; no actual key-pulse channel
assertions: Entire rotated footprint stays within the numeric road, including narrower bridges

limits: Planar checks are approximate and are not native Roblox physics or race-time benchmarks.
Roblox collisions, suspension, roll dynamics, keyboard pulse timing, networking and server validation require live testing.
Road assist reduces risk; sparse obstacle rays and approximate vehicle/road data cannot guarantee collision or rollover prevention.
Full-stage planar driving was checked on Pine Forest and Riverbend Canyon; the other five profiles have geometry/reference checks only.
Menu showcase runs are not verified world records; personal ghost use depends on data the game already loads.
